verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud platform. A cloud console could plausibly offer an AI assistant or AI-generated insights on usage and data, so this axis applies. The evidence covers GPU instances, clusters, JupyterLab, the API, filesystems, monitoring dashboards and billing pages, but nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The community-built MCP server is unofficial and only launches and manages instances; it does not generate insights.
